purpose: Teach: つぶやく/励む/どうのこうの/苦笑い/こぞって/余程/あたらしい/どことなく

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが、お一人でつぶやくのが可愛いわね
lines.en: Sho, it's sweet how your dad mumbles to himself like that.
lines.style: Warm, observant tone with a slight smile in the voice. Gentle pace, almost conspiratorial—noticing something endearing about her husband without judgment. Soft landing on the final word.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、ピアノを毎日励むよ
lines.en: Mom, I'm going to practice piano every day.
lines.style: Quiet determination. Small, serious voice—he's making a promise to himself out loud. Slight breathiness on the opening. No performance, just commitment.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが、どうのこうのと文句を仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad was complaining about various things earlier.
lines.style: Wry, knowing tone—the gentle humor of someone who's heard it all before. Light and unbothered. Slight lift at the end, like she's sharing a small family joke.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お祖父ちゃんが、ぼくの絵を見て苦笑いされてたよ
lines.en: Mom, Grandpa saw my drawing and made that face—you know, where he tries not to laugh.
lines.style: Quiet observation mixed with dry awareness. Small, genuine laugh underneath. Not wounded—just noticing. Matter-of-fact delivery with a hint of knowing.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、ご近所がこぞって運動会を見に来て下さったわ
lines.en: Sho, all the neighbors came to watch your sports day.
lines.style: Pleased and slightly proud. Warm tone, steady pace. The quiet satisfaction of community showing up. Soft emphasis on 'all,' like she's pleased by the gesture itself.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お祖父ちゃんが余程嬉しそうだったよ
lines.en: Mom, Grandpa seemed really happy about it.
lines.style: Bright and eager observation. Voice lifts slightly—genuinely pleased that someone he cares about was happy. Small, authentic enthusiasm without performing.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがあたらしい本を買ってこられたわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad brought home a new book.
lines.style: Gentle, reflective observation. Warm but understated—noticing something small and meaningful about her husband. Unhurried pace, soft trailing-off at the end.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お祖父ちゃんに、どことなく似てる気がするよ
lines.en: Mom, he reminds me of Grandpa in some ways.
lines.style: Quiet, thoughtful delivery. Perceptive—he's noticing a connection between the two people he loves. Hesitant, careful—trying to articulate something he feels but hasn't fully put into words. Soft fadeout.
